description: Add a video transition between two clips at a cut point. Uses QE DOM.

cut_point_seconds.description: Time position in seconds of the cut point where the transition should be placed

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the transition in seconds (default: 1.0)

transition_name.description: Name of the transition (e.g., 'Cross Dissolve', 'Dip to Black')

name: add_transition

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Add Transition
